checkedAlternates.risk: A USB flash drive plugs into the same ports as the keyboard and mouse.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The port is shared, the job is not: a flash drive holds files.

checkedAlternates.risk: A webcam sits next to the monitor and could read as part of the display.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A webcam captures video and sends it into the computer, which makes it an input device.

checkedAlternates.risk: A microphone and speakers both deal with sound.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The microphone brings sound in, the speakers send it out.

authorReview.notes: RAM and touchscreens are left out on purpose because they sit between categories.

blindPlaytest.notes: If testers cannot tell storage from processing, replace the CPU with a graphics card and relabel the row "Does the heavy calculating".
